title.value: Towards Clinical Phenotyping at Scale with Serious Games in Mixed Reality
title.justification: The title clearly identifies the central focus of the paper on clinical phenotyping, serious games, and mixed reality.
title.quote: Towards Clinical Phenotyping at Scale with Serious Games in Mixed Reality

extractions.description: The paper explores the use of serious games in mixed reality as a clinical tool for phenotyping, particularly in the context of autism. It discusses the integration of mixed reality, serious gaming, and machine learning to address challenges in mental healthcare, with a focus on early diagnosis and personalized follow-up. The research presents a proof-of-concept study using a mixed reality game designed for autistic children, aiming to improve clinical accessibility and engagement for mental health evaluations.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on clinical phenotyping in mental healthcare using serious games and mixed reality, which are not central themes to climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Implications: We show that serious games in mixed reality can be a valuable tool to collect clinical data. Our preliminary results highlight important biases to consider for future studies, especially for the sex and context of data collection.
